Components / Surfaces

Alerts log

.dr-log · .dr-sect · .dr-choice · __head · __title · __desc · .dr-chip--unread · components/progress.css · kit specimen

Anatomy

Today

  • Your delivery photo is ready New Package delivery · 10:12
  • Ivan is 2 minutes away New Package delivery · 10:03

Yesterday

  • Rate your order Package delivery · 14:41
  1. 1.dr-logThe column of day groups, 28 apart. Each group is a <section> named by its heading (aria-labelledby). Rows inside a group are 8 apart (.dr-list--snug).
  2. 2.dr-sectThe day heading, a real <h2>: 13/600 --text-muted on the page at 6.62:1, with 12 below it. A screen reader can jump through the days.
  3. 3.dr-choiceThe row: the kit's tappable list row on --bg-surface at radius 16, padding 16, 78 tall (HIG · 44pt 177%). It has no arrow.
  4. 4.dr-choice__titleWhat happened, 17/600 --text-primary at 14.37:1.
  5. 5.dr-chip--unreadNew, a word on the row: --bg-accent-tint behind --text-primary, 14.75:1 at 11/600. It has no dot.
  6. 6.dr-choice__descThe order it belongs to and the time it arrived, 13 --text-muted at 5.95:1, 4 below the title. It is the row's proof (voice P2).

Your delivery photo is ready New Package delivery · 10:12 Rate your order Package delivery · 14:41

An unread and a read row, from notifications.

When to use

The alerts log is the screen notifications for the client and operator-notifications for the operator. Alerts are grouped under days and the unread ones carry a word. Headings are relative and then absolute: Today, Yesterday, then d MMMM, day first for Ukraine and Europe with the month spelled out (HIG · Lists and tables). Read state and recency are two separate facts. An alert can be unread under Yesterday, which the old New / Earlier headings could not say.

The log is not a new component. It is .dr-choice rows in day sections. These alert rows are the only .dr-choice rows that carry __desc, and they carry no chevron. Each row links to the screen the alert is about. It adds no solid green.

The title states the fact in plain words: Your delivery photo is ready, Ivan is 2 minutes away, Order completed. No exclamation marks and no celebration. The second line is the service and the time: Package delivery · 10:12. With no alerts the screen says No notifications yet, the same title on both sides (notifications-empty, operator-notifications-empty). The operator log says the same kind of fact: ₴720 paid to your balance, Documents approved.

Sources: DESIGN.md § The alert log's list row · § The alert rows carry no arrow · inventory.md § 1 Section heading · microcopy.md § notifications-empty · voice.md P2 · ui/kit.html § Alerts log

Rule and anti-rule

Do

Today

  • Ivan is 2 minutes away New Package delivery · 10:03

One day heading over its alerts, each row naming what happened, which order it belongs to, and when.

Don’t

New

  • Your delivery photo is ready Package delivery · 10:12

Earlier

  • Rate your order Package delivery · 14:41

Read state used as the heading. It mixes two facts on one axis, so the log can no longer show an unread alert from yesterday. Group by day and put New on the row. To route the user somewhere, rather than keep a record, use a choice card with its title only.
